messages:
rachel: Heads-up — I'm putting a short proposal on the table for how we surface degraded-routing errors to clients and the console. Goal: consistent client-facing wording + actionable SDK hints so customers can handle transient degradation gracefully.

sam: +1. What are you thinking for the actual payload? keep it tiny plz.

rachel: Minimal fields only. Example I sketched:```json
{
  "code": "route_degraded",
  "message": "Primary model overloaded, serving at reduced capacity",
  "client_hint": "retryable",
  "retry_after_ms": 250
}
```Clients can map client_hint -> retry behavior; console shows a yellow degraded badge with the message and sample retry header.

lee: I like the retry_after_ms but we should avoid exposing internal routing ids. No opaque topology stuff in messages.

nora: Agreed. Also: we already tag spans with route.reason in traces. We can add a telemetry-only field route_reason that is NOT forwarded to clients. That keeps us safe for internal debugging.

emily: UX question — should console show aggregated counts of degraded occurrences per route? ops wants per-tenant counts + a timeline.

rachel: Yes: console -> Route health panel: counts, recent samples (scrubbed), and the client-facing badge copy. We should also show the SDK snippet to honor retry_after_ms.

sam: On HTTP semantics: map client_hint values to status codes: retryable -> 503 or 429? What do we pick for SDKs to surface consistently?

lee: My take: use 429 for rate/quota, 503 for transient overload/degraded. Keep a stable mapping in the API contract doc so SDKs don't guess.

nora: We should define a small taxonomy: ["retryable_transient", "quota_exhausted", "client_error", "terminal_failure"]. Each maps to an HTTP code set and a console badge color. That keeps the UX consistent.

emily: If we implement that taxonomy, product can author suggested retries per bucket (e.g., exponential backoff for retryable_transient).

rachel: Implementation notes: runtime will add client_hint header only when route policy decides to degrade/fallback; when falling back to cheaper model we set client_hint="fallback_suggestion" and include fallback_model in telemetry only. We will not include fallback_model in the client response.

sam: Security check — confirm PII never leaks via message. We'll add a scrub step before anything goes to console samples.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/error-hints-api v2 -> staging at 2025-06-12T21:40Z :rocket:

lee: For SDKs: add a standardized helper:````js
// pseudo
if (resp.client_hint === 'retryable_transient') {
  const wait = resp.retry_after_ms || computeBackoff();
  await sleep(wait);
  retry();
}
````

nora: Action items: 1) rachel to author RFC with sample payloads and schema (include mapping table). 2) sam & lee to draft SDK snippet and mapping. 3) emily to mock console badge + Route health panel. 4) security scrub checklist added to RFC.

rachel: I'll draft RFC by EOD tomorrow and include sample console screenshots + telemetry tag list. Thanks all :thumbsup:
